To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
sleep deprivation is a serious problem among students worldwide and that heavy use of digital media is an important factor contributing to student sleep deprivation.

(1) global prevalence of sleep deficiency in students has been found by the two latest international student assessments; (2) sleep deficiency is related to poor academic performance; (3) heavy media use, including digital game play, is a major contributor to sleep deficiency; and (4) sleep deficiency can be improved through programs that include sleep hygiene and sleep restriction.

(a) sleep deprivation is a global problem in students, (b) heavy media use, including digital game play, is a possible contributor to sleep deprivation, and (c) educational researchers should pay greater attention on student sleep and work with other researchers and stakeholders to develop programs and interventions for improving sleep in students.

the following question: Why is sleep deprivation so prevalent in students?
the impact of heavy media use on sleep deprivation in students.
the global prevalence of sleep deficiency and heavy media use in students and the implications for educational research and practice.
